native_mechanisms: Lay both cords' symbol-shaped coils in parallel rows and walk them together, counting one 'fire' per exact positional match (diagonal match-count scan).
Allow the boundary between the rows to break exactly once per crossing, letting the shadow row crouch one coil past a quarrel — i.e. enumerate alignments with at most a single gap/offset slip.
Store each crossing's total in its own room, sink failed/twice-broken crossings into the unread tower, and bring back only the highest pile as the answer (max over all admissible crossings).
core_technique: Banded Needleman-Wunsch with an AVX2 anti-diagonal wavefront, where an O(n) prefix-sum scan over all ≤1-gap alignments supplies a lower bound that (via score ≤ n − 5g) bounds the band width and occasionally proves the answer outright.
